notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
Another post launch patch! We've upgraded the game to use the new Godot Engine version 4.4, which comes with several performance improvements and some tweaks to the physics implementations. We've also added an easier way to complete the Daredevil achievement with the chance of a dump truck conveniently in front of the train tracks.

Keep delivering those packages!
